description: Use this when the user asks for a campaign join link or to invite one or more creators. Without displayName: a fresh OPEN join link for the campaign (anyone with it can join; making a new one turns the old one off). With displayName (and optional email and accounts): invites ONE creator and returns their PERSONAL link, where they add accounts, submit posts and see earnings; a personal invite skips approval, and a creator with a Hermoso creator portal sees it there. With creators: a personal link and a ready-to-send message for each; one already in the campaign is skipped by name. HEADLESS SIGN-UP (your own sign-up page): embed:true returns the widget script, an iframe and the public sign-up endpoint; signup { displayName, email, accounts, answers } returns a confirmUrl where the creator agrees and joins (agreements are always the creator's own clicks, never sent). Hermoso sends nothing itself (email_campaign_creator emails one when asked).

accounts.description: the accounts they post from, if you know them

embed.description: the widget / iframe / endpoint to put the sign-up on your own site

signup.description: sign a creator up from your own form: returns the confirmUrl they finish on
